headline: China says AI-assisted labor mediation and arbitration pilots now cover all provincial-level regions
summary: On 2 November 2026, China’s Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security reported expanding its “AI+ mediation and arbitration” pilot to all provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps. Earlier official material documents pilots in 13 provincial-level jurisdictions. A Shenzhen HRSS-hosted article, credited in its footer to Nanfang+ client, describes a local arbitration-assistance system and reports usage and processing-time metrics; those figures are unverified. The national expansion statement does not establish uniform operation, dispute outcomes, fairness, safety or independent effectiveness.
